implementation_source.name: coleygroup/ms-pred MAGMa fragment enumerator
reused_fields: neutralized fragment formula and exact mass

scientific_evidence.implemented_semantics: Positive-mode regular first and later cleavage hypotheses are represented as element-conditioned plus/minus one hydrogen variants. Other variants within plus/minus two hydrogens are retained only as lower-prior semiresolved hypotheses.
scientific_evidence.boundary: This implementation does not claim to reproduce the complete MS-FINDER program, its learned database score, or every diagrammatic rule in Figure 1.

scientific_evidence.implemented_semantics: Observed peaks are rewarded only through a rooted connected explanation over candidate-fragment parent-child edges; unmatched intermediate fragments may connect observed descendants and every added edge pays an explicit complexity cost.
scientific_evidence.boundary: The local solver is a deterministic greedy prize-collecting approximation, not the SIRIUS ILP and not a SIRIUS score reproduction.

scientific_evidence.implemented_semantics: Candidate structures are expanded into explicit multi-step fragment DAGs with atom-subset identities and hydrogen-shift variants.
scientific_evidence.boundary: No pretrained ICEBERG intensity model is used, preventing MassSpecGym checkpoint overlap from becoming supervision.

training_contract.output: candidate score ledger with matched controls and an auditable connected explanation ledger
forbidden: using fragment-graph scores as a regression or distillation target
changing the DreaMS loss, sampler, optimizer, or event weights
broadcasting a relation to another query or identity
opening formula roles 2, 3, or 4 during construction or qualification
matched_controls: within-candidate fragment-mass-to-graph-node permutation preserving graph topology, mass multiset, hydrogen variants, and capacity
within-candidate parent-topology permutation preserving node and edge capacity
deterministic peak-mass shift preserving peak count and intensities
training_contract.unused_audit_arm: The core retains a within-query intensity-rank permutation for bounded diagnostics, but the formal full run does not compute it because it neither qualifies the source nor selects a triplet.
training_contract.required_next_gate: formula-disjoint specificity qualification against every matched control before native triplet mining
